CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress Kafka port to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to Kafka port (TCP: 9092).
Risk: This port handles Kafka message broker communications. Attackers can intercept sensitive messages in event streams, inject malicious data into processing pipelines, or disrupt distributed systems by manipulating consumer offsets.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
